decision.capital_and_accounting: No trade, margin, or capital state is touched; this is a descriptive re-derivation from already-accepted bytes only.
decision.if_screen_fails: Record NETH25 as friction-infeasible for breakout-fade at current cost structure; retain the broader 1578-symbol frontier as open and unaffected.
decision.if_screen_passes: Prospectively define a finite breakout-fade NETH25 exact specification (entry/exit/horizon/cost law) as a candidate for a future execution-authorization gate; do not open its economic outcome in this proposal.
decision.method: Reuse the frozen event law (event_lookback_bars=24, event_volatility_expansion_ratio=1.5) and the frozen 15m/30m follow-through horizons already applied at the 40-symbol development level. Apply them to the accepted NETH25 cost-capture bytes only, then subtract the accepted broker-native spread/commission transaction-local cost from the observed post-event move at each frozen horizon. Report only descriptive friction-adjusted event counts and pass/fail rate per horizon; no PnL curve, no ranking across symbols, no parameter search, no significance test.
decision.no_outer_reuse: Does not touch the completed SESSION_GAP six-panel or four-panel independent outers; this is a distinct BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION prerequisite step operating only on already-accepted NETH25 development/cost bytes.

objective.goal: Use the already-accepted NETH25 transaction-local cost and M5 capture to compute a non-economic, friction-adjusted realizability screen for the breakout-fade mechanism at NETH25, resolving whether real broker-native costs plausibly permit a future economic identity before any attempt is consumed.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The pre-economic realizability audit found all 40 development-representative symbols EUR200-feasible but lacking transaction-local cost authority. NETH25 now has an accepted, hash-verified, pre-outcome cost+M5 capture. Computing friction-adjusted event economics descriptively (spread/commission-adjusted move vs. observed breakout-fade event magnitude) from this already-accepted evidence is the smallest legal step that converts existing accepted bytes into a go/no-go signal for prospective identity definition, without opening any economic outcome, consuming an attempt, or requesting new market data.
